WITH w AS (SELECT 'CY' per, DATE '2026-08-03' s, DATE '2026-08-30' e UNION ALL SELECT 'LY', DATE '2025-07-28', DATE '2025-08-24'),
sl AS (SELECT w.per, s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) net_all, sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount END) net_ex_staff, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) days
 FROM w JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sale_date BETWEEN w.s AND w.e JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2),
rt AS (SELECT w.per, s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) refunds FROM w JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.return_date BETWEEN w.s AND w.e JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2),
rp AS (SELECT w.per, r.store_id, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) gross, sum(r.returns_net) rets, sum(r.net_sales) ns, count(*) days FROM w JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date BETWEEN w.s AND w.e WHERE r.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT sl.per, sl.store_id, round(sl.net_all,0) net_all, round(sl.net_ex_staff,0) ex_staff, sl.days, round(rt.refunds,0) refunds, round(rp.gross,0) rpt_gross, round(rp.rets,0) rpt_rets, round(rp.ns,0) rpt_ns, rp.days rpt_days
FROM sl LEFT JOIN rt USING (per, store_id) LEFT JOIN rp USING (per, store_id) ORDER BY sl.store_id, sl.per DESC

WITH periods AS (
  SELECT 'CY' AS per, DATE '2026-08-03' AS s, DATE '2026-08-30' AS e
  UNION ALL SELECT 'LY', DATE '2025-07-28', DATE '2025-08-24'),
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM dim_store
  WHERE store_id < 900 AND store_id NOT IN (129, 136, 137)),
sales AS (
  SELECT p.per, st.store_id, f.net_amount AS amt
  FROM periods p JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE st.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.per, st.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM periods p JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE st.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)),
tot AS (SELECT per, sum(amt) AS net_sales, count(DISTINCT store_id) AS n_stores FROM sales GROUP BY per)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period,
  round((cy.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1) * 100, 2) AS lfl_net_sales_growth_pct,
  cy.net_sales AS cy_net, ly.net_sales AS ly_net, cy.n_stores AS cy_n, ly.n_stores AS ly_n
FROM tot cy, tot ly WHERE cy.per = 'CY' AND ly.per = 'LY'
